reason: I take the free 15-company list first, and if the companies are real buyers I would actually call, I start the pilot, because I pay nothing up front and the first 3 meetings are free. That is the proof I never got from the last agency. EUR 2,800 at most is about what I spend on one trade fair stand, so it is a fair comparison.
objection: Your proof is one logistics client. I am a wholesaler. Do you know who buys in my category in that country, or will you send me 'decision-makers' who take a call to be polite and never order? And I worry I will spend my time arguing over which meetings count instead of selling.
would_change_my_mind: If the free list of 15 has more than a few names that are wrong for my category, or companies I already know and have tried, I walk away and do not start the pilot.
